pages.text: The $(item)Alloy Furnace$() has 9 ingredient slots, a fuel slot and an output. Ingredients may lie in any slots.$(br2)$(li)Copper + 4 Redstone = $(item)Signal Alloy Ingot$()$(br)$(li)Silver + 4 Azurite = $(item)Power Alloy Ingot$()$(br)$(li)3 Copper + Tin = 4 $(item)Brass$()

The $(item)Power Alloy Furnace$() does the same on 25 FE/t, twice as fast, and has a battery slot.$(br2)Automation: ingredients from the top, fuel from the sides, results from the bottom. Custom recipes use the $(item)redcircuit:alloying$() recipe type (datapacks, KubeJS, CraftTweaker).
